A pale warm identity panel and rounded section dividers give a gentle visual character. Keep body text dark and use square, quiet print geometry when space is tight.
A slate identity sidebar carries contacts and concise qualifications, beside a white experience column. Use a broad enough rail for long credentials and natural mobile stacking.
Open the masthead across the page and place a light green supporting column on the right. Fine vertical rules separate information without enclosing each entry in a card.
A precise blue name and small uppercase professional label lead an open single column. Small square section markers add orientation without icons or decorative ratings.

A narrow lavender qualifications rail complements a crisp French-labelled career column. Use a confident sans identity and clean role/date alignment rather than ornamental flourishes.
